description: This is a source file defining the ShareViewController class for an iOS share extension. It handles extracting shared content (text, URLs, images), managing UI elements, and sending data to a remote gateway via network requests. It also includes methods for processing shared attachments, composing drafts, and interacting with external services.
external_methods: share extension methods: loadURL, loadText, loadDataRepresentation

classes.name: ShareViewController
classes.description: A view controller managing the share extension UI and logic, including content extraction, UI setup, draft editing, and message sending.

methods.name: viewDidLoad
methods.description: Initial setup when the view loads, including setting preferred size and UI setup.

methods.name: viewDidAppear
methods.description: Ensures draft is prepared when the view appears for the first time.

methods.name: setupUI
methods.description: Configures the user interface elements, including text view and buttons.

methods.name: prepareDraft
methods.description: Asynchronously extracts shared content, composes a draft message, and updates the UI.

methods.name: handleSendTap
methods.description: Coroutine triggered when Send button is tapped, initiates message sending.

methods.name: handleCancelTap
methods.description: Handles cancellation, ending the extension.

methods.name: sendCurrentDraft
methods.description: Sends the composed message and attachments to the gateway and manages success/failure UI updates.

methods.name: sendMessageToGateway
methods.description: Constructs payload and establishes connection to the gateway to send the message and attachments.

methods.name: shouldRetryWithLegacyClientId
methods.description: Analyzes error details to determine if a retry with a different client ID is necessary.

methods.name: showStatus
methods.description: Displays status messages overlayed on the UI.

methods.name: composeDraft
methods.description: Generates draft text from payload components, sanitizing content.

methods.name: sanitizeDraftFragment
methods.description: Cleans up raw text fragments, filtering out banned phrases.

methods.name: extractSharedContent
methods.description: Parses shared items (text, URLs, images, files) from the extension context input items.

methods.name: loadImageAttachment
methods.description: Loads, processes, and encodes shared images into ShareAttachment objects.

methods.name: preferredImageTypeIdentifier
methods.description: Identifies the preferred image type from provider types.

methods.name: normalizedJPEGData
methods.description: Compresses images into JPEG under maximum byte size.

methods.name: loadURL
methods.description: Loads a URL from an NSItemProvider.

methods.name: loadText
methods.description: Loads text content from an NSItemProvider.

methods.name: loadURLValue
methods.description: Helper to extract URL value from provider.

methods.name: loadTextValue
methods.description: Helper to extract text value from provider.

methods.name: loadDataValue
methods.description: Loads raw data from provider for a given type identifier.
